in_game_name: screen-wide flashing balls, like flash, sun, and flicker
text: I think screen-wide flashing balls, like flash, sun, and flicker, confer whatever status effect is on the other fused ball to everything on screen. This includes things that stack, like overgrowth, as well as instant kills like black hole.

claims.detail: General composition rule proposed by a Steam user: screen-wide flashers (Flash / Sun / Flicker) spread the partner ball's on-hit status (including stack effects and instant-kill) to everything on screen. Names the flasher CATEGORY, not a single pair. Matches the Reddit status-vs-spawn rule's status half.

text: Yes, Flash/Flicker + any status ball is generally very busted.  Flash/Flicker + hemo will destroy bosses thanks to doing HP% damage.  If you can't get either of those, Sun also works as a great status spreader.

claims.detail: Composition rule: screen-wide flashers (Flash/Flicker, and Sun as a fallback) spread any partner's status. Most explicit Steam restatement of the status-spreading rule. Names the flasher CATEGORY, not a single pair.
